_comment: Hand-off for the arm collision-avoidance evaluation bench (sim-arm-collision-bench-v1). Keys, scenario list, thresholds and the before/after numbers. The bench is opt-in and byte-identical off for the mission (it is not imported or launched by any mission path). See scripts/twin/tools/README.md.

cpu_mode.needs: numpy + usd-core (optional, for gpu-side authoring tests); no Isaac/ROS/GPU

args.--gate: baseline | reference | module:function (a sibling lane's real gate)
args.--observe-all: model full perception coverage (the AFTER-coverage column)
args.--urdf / --curobo: override the mission URDF / curobo collision-sphere yml

cpu_mode.exit_code: 0 iff every scenario passed its thresholds (CI / pre-send gate)

gpu_mode.extends: scripts/run_arm_carry_bench.py (boot Isaac once, author obstacles into the stage, read live AABB clearance + PhysX contact)
gpu_mode.bounded: <= 20 min, gpu_budget-gated, canonical GPU lock, never --force; integration lane (coldwin*) has priority
gpu_mode.command: renice +10 -p $$ >/dev/null; flock -w 5 /tmp/aile-gpu.lock env_isaaclab/bin/python scripts/run_arm_collision_bench_gpu.py --runtime-config <mission-runtime.json> --scenarios docs/examples/arm-collision-scenarios --legs collect_pick --heavy-threshold-mb 2500 --no-gpu-lock --out <scratch>/gpu-collect
gpu_mode.vram_scout_s7: collect/carry/set-down ~2.9 GB free (mast +0.45, dynamic layer +1.1 both fit); live_pose transfer 26 MiB free -> bench nothing extra there

gates.baseline: the current stack: no perceived-ESDF gate on these arm legs -> never acts (BEFORE)
gates.reference: a transparent collision-aware reference instrument (people routed to the human-gate STOP, cart as a known world obstacle); reacts only to what it PERCEIVES
gates.module:function: a sibling lane's real gate; signature (scenario, list[FrameClearance]) -> GateVerdict(behavior, n_replans, extra_cycle_time_s, reason)

scenario_schema.arm_leg: collect_pick | carry | preplace_approach | set_down | withdraw | transfer
scenario_schema.expected_behavior: avoid | preempt_replan | slow_stop_resume | refuse | clear | none
scenario_schema.voxel_m: mock ESDF voxel size (default 0.01 = the mission arm ESDF; the real cell runs 0.02)

obstacles.name: str (suffix drives nothing; use at_goal flag)
obstacles.observed: bool - false models the current stack's ESDF blindness (unobserved == free; the body still physically exists for the GPU contact probe)
obstacles.at_goal: bool - obstacle sits ON the leg's reach target (refuse vs avoid)

motion.class: static | person | hand | carton | box | tool | cage

scenarios.note: wrist pre-grasp view; collision-aware already works

scenarios.closed_by: cart as a cuMotion world obstacle
cart world obstacle + straight-line-insert ESDF gate

scenarios.note: human gate STOP where the wrist perceives

before_after_numbers._source: CPU mock-ESDF, 8 scenarios, margin 30 mm, this branch (fm/sim-arm-collision-bench-v1)

reference_current_coverage.note: works on the 3 wrist-framed cases; 5 blind spots = the measured gap

reference_after_coverage_observe_all.note: S5: no contact static, STOP-not-contact moving, once the stack SEES the obstacles

before_after_numbers.after_sibling_gate: PENDING - plug --gate <sibling module:function> once the cart-world-obstacle / insert-gate / humangate-preempt PRs merge on fm/twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1
before_after_numbers.gpu: PENDING - bounded collect-only run (command above) when the lock is free after the integration lane
